Commentary.Commentary: We are back. Orla Prendergast to bowl first. Sophia Dunkley and Danni Wyatt to bat for England.
...THE CHASE...

Ireland Women lost 8 wickets for just 25 runs and that tells you the story. From a stage of posting 150 runs, Ireland have fallen well short. Apart from the top four, everyone went for a single-digit score. Now, the batting is done. The spinners are getting enough purchases from this pitch. Can Ireland Women replicate what England players did? We will find out soon.

Ireland could not have started a better way as the openers played some fine shots and were dealing in boundaries. England at that time looked without any answers as the runs were coming easily. However, the spinners got their rhythm lately and the wickets started to come by. It was then the over from Sophie Ecclestone where she struck twice was the turning point. There was no coming back for Ireland from there on. The spinners bossed the show as out of 10 wickets, 8 of them went to the spinners.
Wow! That was quick from England! They did turn up in the later stages and have bamboozled Ireland. What a performance from the English bowlers!
OUT! TAKEN! On a length and on middle, slower ball. Jane Maguire just chips it straight to mid-wicket where the fielder takes a simple catch. Ireland Women are bowled out for 105.
Commentary.Howout: c Natalie Sciver b Katherine Brunt

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, full, punched to point.
A slower ball on middle. Murray tucks it to mid-wicket.
A bumper outside off, Murray offers no shot.
Another single as this is hit to square leg.
On middle, worked to deep mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, kept out.
On a length and outside off, Murray looks to punch but misses.

OUT! BOWLED! Sophie Ecclestone ends with three! The skipper goes now and this is not looking good for Ireland! Sophie Ecclestone steams a yorker on middle, Delany did not see that coming and fails to jam it out either. The ball hits the base of middle.
Played all over it! Flighted down leg. Delany tries to sweep but mistimes it on the deck.
Very full and on off, Delany jams it back to the bowler.
Quick single! Outside off, driven to mid off for a single.
Tossed up on middle, kept out.
Full and outside off, eased to long off for a single.
Outside off this time, slower ball. Murray leaves it alone.
Banged in, outside off. Murray lets it go.
Slower again, worked to deep cover for asingle.
FOUR! 100 up! Full and outside off, Delany drives it through point and it races into the fence.
Slower ball, full and outside off, Murray slices it over point for one.

OUT! TAKEN! Bell gets one to her name! This is full and outside off, Kelly makes room as she tries to go over covers but fails to execute her shot and Heather Knight at covers takes a sharp catch over her head. What a turnaround this is from England.
Commentary.Howout: c Heather Knight b Lauren Bell

Commentary.Commentary: Very full on off, Kelly toe ends her lofted shot to mid off and the fielder picks up on a bounce. One.
Very full on middle. Kelly blocks it.

OUT! BOWLED! England are on a rampage. Shorter and around off. Paul swings her bat in the air trying to cut but misses and the ball hits the stumps. The skipper is watching players come and go from the other end.
Tossed up on middle, spins in. Paul looks to reverse hit but misses and gets hit high on the pads.

OUT! LBW! Waldron takes a review after being given LBW out. Umpire's call it is on wickets hitting and Waldron has to walk back. A leggie from Glenn, flighted just around off, Waldron misses her sweep and gets hit on the back pad. She is given out and is convinced but in the last seconds tries her luck and take it upstairs but in vain.
On middle, kept out.
Outside off, nudged to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! That is cheeky! Flat and on middle, slower ball. Waldron reverse hits it past short third man for a four.

OUT! TAKEN! What a catch by Sophie Ecclestone! She is busy in the last few minutes! Little tries to go big again, this is outside off, Little slices her shot to the left of mid off where Sophie Ecclestone runs, dives and holds on despite banging with the ground.
Commentary.Howout: c Sophie Ecclestone b Charlotte Dean

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! BANG! Welcome boundary! Too full and on off. Little uses her feet and smacks it high over long off for a biggie.
Fuller and outside off, Littler strokes it past point for two more.
A googly on middle. Delany tickles it to short fine leg for one.
Fuller and on off, Little pushes it to cover. Double-wicket maiden over by Sophie Ecclestone. Is this the turning point for England?
Full and outside off, driven to cover.

OUT! LBW! Two in two for Sophie Ecclestone! Tossed up on middle, slanting in. Eimear Richardson looks to sweep but misses and gets hit completely. An appeal and up goes the finger. Eimear Richardson doesn't even waste much time as she starts to walk out. Sophie Ecclestone is on a Hat-trick.

OUT! TAKEN! No boundaries in last couple of overs and the pressure results in a wicket! This is full and on middle. Lewis looks to slog-sweep but gets a leading edge to deep square leg. Danni Wyatt shifts to her left and holds onto it this time.
Commentary.Howout: c Danni Wyatt b Sophie Ecclestone

Commentary.Commentary: Goes very full on off, Lewis jams it out to the bowler.
Tossed up on off, Defended out.
Short and outside off. Delany looks to pull but misses.
Wide! Down the leg side, wided.

Leg bye! Not a good review from England. A back of the hand delivery, length and outside off. Lewis looks to pull but misses and gets hit high on the back pad. A muted appeal follows but Sciver convinces it to take it upstairs. The replay shows the impact was well outside off.
Good shot for two! Short and on middle, this is pulled to deep square leg for two.
On a length and on middle. Delany whips it behind square leg for one.
On off, defended.
On middle, Lewis pulls it hard to deep square leg. The fielder runs to her right and gets a hand on it. It still rolls behind but the fielder is quick to sweep it back. Good job. Saves one.
Tossed up on off, Lewis sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one more.
On off, pushed to covers for one.
On middle, swept behind square leg for one.
TWO LEG BYES! This one lands on leg and turns in. Lewis misses her flick. It goes behind to third man where the fielder makes a solid stop diving forward.
Tihs is full and on the pads. Lewis looks to sweep but misses.
Full and outside off, driven to cover.
On middle, Lewis gets low and picks it up to hit towards deep square leg. One.

Leg bye! Goes slow and full now on leg. Delany misses her flick and gets hit on the pads. An appeal but that was going down. There is a run out chance but the fielder at backward point misses her shy at the bowler's side.
Short again, this is pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Delany is surprised with a bouncer and the batter goes for the pull shot but gets a top edge. It goes over cover for one.
Length ball, outside off, Lewis punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Outside off, guided to third man for one.
FOUR! Whatever the circumstances, boundaries keep on coming regularly! Full and outside off, Lewis hammers it down past mid off for four.
Outside off, skids through. Delany cuts it past point for one.
Short and on off, Delany dabs it to short third man.

OUT! BOWED! One shot too many! Prendergast goes! Glenn serves it full and around off, fractionally stays low. Prendergast is through to her shot as she skips down to heave but misses. The ball shatters the stumps.
FOUR! Prendergast is batting with intent! Too full and outside off. Prendergast skips down, opens her body and lifts it over covers for four.
Half-a-chance! Flatter and on middle. Lewis hits uppishly to the right of Glenn who gets her hand out but instead gets hit on the wrists. A single.
On a length and on middle, Prendergast nudges it to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is hit past mid-wicket for a brace.
Leg bye! Slower ball, around off. Lewis looks to sweep but gets on the body. The impact was outside the line. England Women put up a muted appaeal. A leg bye.
A bouncer, outside off, Prendergast slaps it to mid on for one more.
On a length and around off. Prendergast blocks it out.
Length and on off, kept out.
Outside off, punched to cover.

England Women need to do well! They look too casual! Outside off, Prendergast hits it to short third man. The fielder dives over the ball. Sophie Ecclestone gives a chase, slides. Her right foot was dragged but but she does well to keep the ball away. Three runs.
Tossed up on off, Prendergast works it to mid off.
Around off, pushed through covers for one.
Another delay in the play. The stump mic needs to be repaired again.
This is on middle. Prendergast works it to mid on for a single. The fielder scores a direct-hit at the bowler's end and puts in a half-hearted appeal. The replay shows Prendergast was well in.
Shorter and on middle, quicker. Prendergast miscues her pull shot to mid-wicket.
Angles it on the pads, helped to short fine leg for one.
Flighted full and outside off. Prendergast looks to drive but misses.
FOUR! HIT HARD! Tossed up, outside off. Prendergast comes down the track and thumps it past cover for four.
Floated on off, spins n. Lewis chips it to long on for one.
This one spins on middle, Prendergast tucks it to mid-wicket for one.

OUT! TAKEN! England break the stand! That was much needed! Hunter hits this well, this is full and outside off, she slogs it but was targetting the longer side. Sophia Dunkley at deep mid-wicket takes the catch with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c Sophia Dunkley b Charlotte Dean

Commentary.Commentary: A good start for Ireland! Full and outside off, knocked through covers for one.
Too full and outside off, driven to mid off.
Flighted outside off, Hunter defends it.
In the air but falls safely! Fuller and outside off. Hunter skips down and lofts it over mid off. Only gets height and results in two runs.
Outside off, guided to point for one.
FOUR! Full and outside off. Lewis sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. Natalie Sciver was standing across but fails to pick up. Apologizes for it straightaway.
A cable wire has come out near the stumps and there is an unnecessary halt. It needs to be fixed up.  Gaby Lewis meanwhile is in some pain. The physio is assisting her shoulder.
This is way outside off and spins in. Hunter looks to drive but misses.
A single as this is lofted to long on.
On off, kept out.
This one lands on middle and spins on the pads. Lewis again looks to reverse hit but misses. Just going down.
FOUR! The boundaries keep on coming! This is full and on off, slower in the air. Lewis goes for the reverse sweep and hits it fine to third man for four.
Leg bye! On the pads, Hunter fails to flick and it goes off the pads to square leg.

Full and going down with the angle, Lewis looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. Sophie Ecclestone is interested and makes her skipper quiestion as well but eventually they end up not reviewing it.
Very full and outside off. Hunter hits it over covers for just a single.
This time Lewis sweeps and finds deep mid-wicket. A single.
Slower again, angling down. Lewis misses her sweep and gets hit on the pads.
Flat and outside off. Lewis steps across to sweep but misses.
A direct-hit was needed! On off, Hunter prods and defends to cover for a quick single. It was a risky but the fielder misses her shy at the bowler's end.
Good end by Brunt! Length and on off, Lewis defends.
Length and on off, Blocked out.
A slower bumper on middle, Hunter looks to pull but gets a top edge. It falls freely at the fine leg region. One.
FOUR MORE! Ireland Women are dealing in fours! Full and outside off. Hunter skips down, goes away and smacks it wide of mid off for a straight boundary.
On a length and on middle, Amy defends.
FOUR! IN THE GAP! What a start for Ireland! Very full and outside off, swings away. Hunter leans and drives through point for four.
Katherine Brunt to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! And the drop catch results in a four! Not a good start by England! Very full on middle, this is flicked over mid-wicket for four.
PUT DOWN! Lewis gets an early life! Length ball, outside off. Lewis punches on the up to the right of point. Danni Wyatt dives and fails to hold on. Was at a catchable height.
This one tails back in sharply. Full and on the pads. Lewis looks to flick but misses.
On a length and on middle. Blocked out.
FOUR! Lewis is off the mark as well! On a length and outside off, nips in. Lewis carves it past backward point for a boundary.
Swing on offer for Bell! This is full and outside off, swings in. Hunter pushes nicely but finds cover. A single is taken. Ireland Women are off the mark.

Done with the anthems. It is time for action. The English players are out in the middle. Lauren Bell to bowl first. Amy Hunter and Gaby Lewis to open with the bat. Both teams take a knee before the start of the proceedings. Here we go...
We are all set. First, it's time for the national anthems. It is England's first followed by Ireland's national anthem.

England Women (Playing XI) - Sophia Dunkley, Danni Wyatt, Alice Capsey, Natalie Sciver, Heather Knight (C), Amy Jones (WK), Katherine Brunt, Sophie Ecclestone, Charlotte Dean, Sarah Glenn, Lauren Bell.
Ireland Women (Playing XI) - Amy Hunter, Gaby Lewis, Orla Prendergast, Laura Delany (C), Eimear Richardson, Louise Little, Mary Waldron (WK), Leah Paul, Arlene Kelly, Cara Murray, Jane Maguire.
TOSS - Ireland Women have won the toss and will BAT first!

Hello and welcome to the action of group B where we will see Ireland Women take on England Women. We can see the bets are on the latter to win this match comfortably but after seeing Sri Lanka hammer down the hosts in the opening match, we can expect one thing from this minnow teams is a real fight. Ireland Women will kick off their season while England Women have already played one game as they demolished West Indies. To go further in the tournament, it is important for Ireland Women to start positively and kick off with a win however, England Women will hope to keep their favorite tags on without any dirt. Stay tuned for toss and other updates.

Get ready for the third game of Group B between Ireland Women and England Women at Boland Park in Paarl. The latter is one of the favourites in this edition of the ICC Women's T20 World Cup and on paper, this clash appears to be a mismatch. The English team is a ruthless unit with plenty of firepower in batting and quality in bowling. They are a well-oiled side with all the bases covered and the way they demolished West Indies Women in their tournament opener speaks volumes about their strength. It's tough to find a loophole in their batting department and if anything, their bowling can get better in the Powerplay. Certainly, we cannot talk about Ireland Women in the same vein but their recent achievement of beating Australia Women in one of the warm-up games cannot be undermined. The Irish team has progressed well in the recent past under the leadership of Laura Delany and with star players like Amy Hunter and Leah Paul in their squad, they have the ability to put up a fight. They own a young squad with decent quality and this tournament is going to be a great exposure for them. The men's Irish team has enjoyed success against England in the marquee event, can the ladies do the same? Let's hope for a competitive game.
